name: abex-pumps-website
description: ABEX Pumps website with minification build process

scripts.build:css: cleancss -o assets/css/main.min.css assets/css/main-styles.css && cleancss -o assets/css/contact.min.css assets/css/contact-styles.css && cleancss -o assets/css/product.min.css assets/css/product-styles.css && cleancss -o assets/css/project.min.css assets/css/project-styles.css
scripts.build:js: uglifyjs assets/js/main.js -o assets/js/main.min.js -c -m && uglifyjs assets/js/projects.js -o assets/js/projects.min.js -c -m
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js

author: ABEX Pumps
